why: The dedicated read-only market plane the owner specified (ops/render_market_plane_service.yaml, owner decision 2026-10-06; Kalshi rep production contract 2026-10-07): the universal market plane on ONE PMX subscribe-all market-data stream plus the authenticated Kalshi WebSocket order-book runtime, on its own service. Kalshi documents no read-only API key class (docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/api_keys, 2026-10-08: Ed25519 or RSA keys, no scopes), so the boundary is the process: market_plane_guard locks it against venue writes, blocks every order-client module from import and refuses to run beside any order-capable credential. Every value is the existing one, copied unchanged from sportsassets-workers (which already holds all six); none is created or edited.
name: sportsassets-market-plane
